{{DG|+100 Walk Speed Cap}} }} '''Young Dragon Armor'''{{'}}s {{AN|Young Blood}} full set bonus grants {{Stat|spd|+150}} while above {{Stat|hp|50%}} and increases the player's {{Stat|spd}} cap by {{Stat|spd|+100|icononly=yes}}. == Essence Crafting == {{Essence Crafting |type = armor |h1=20 |h2=30 |h3=50 |h4=100 |h5=150 |h_convert = 40 |c1=30 |c2=50 |c3=80 |c4=120 |c5=180 |c_convert = 70 |l1=25 |l2=40 |l3=65 |l4=110 |l5=160 |l_convert = 60 |b1=20 |b2=30 |b3=40 |b4=90 |b5=140 |b_convert = 35 |essence = Dragon }} == Skins == {{Item Skins|Young Dragon Helmet}} == Trivia == *'''Young Dragon Armor''' is one of four dragon armors to have coloring similar to its main stat bonus. The white color of the armor is the same white color of the {{stat|spd}} stat. **The other three armors that have similar colors to their stats are {{Item|Strong Dragon Armor}}, {{Item|Wise Dragon Armor}}, and {{Item|Holy Dragon Armor}}. *Ignoring the set bonus, '''Young Dragon Armor''' grants the second highest {{stat|spd}} out of any [[Armor]] set, behind {{Item|Maxor's Armor}}. **Including the set bonus, '''Young Dragon Armor''' grants the highest {{stat|spd}} out of any armor set, giving {{stat|spd|30}} more than {{Item|Maxor's Armor}}. ==Notes== * The {{stat|spd}} cap increase stacks with other sources. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2019/August 2|[[File:Young Dragon Armor.png|26px]] Added '''Young Dragon Armor'''.}} {{History|2019/December 18|+13 Speed per piece (from 7 to 20 each, 52 extra speed total).|Speed cap when wearing the set is increased to 500% (from 400%).}} {{History|2020/July 1|Added {{Skl|Combat}} level 16 requirement.}} {{History|2021/March 30|{{Skl|Catacombs}} requirements lowered to 15.| '''Young Dragon Armor''' essence costs reduced to *Helmet: Upgrade 40 and 20/30/50/100/150 Dragon Essence per star. *Chestplate: Upgrade 70 and 30/50/80/120/180 Dragon Essence per star. *Leggings: Upgrade 60 and 25/40/65/110/160 Dragon Essence per star. *Boots: Upgrade 35 and 20/30/40/90/140 Dragon Essence per star.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Armors}} [[Category:The End]] [[Category:Dragon Armor]]
